description: This Java source file defines the class 'ChangeLogVersionFinder', which provides methods to retrieve and manage Liquibase change log versions and related filenames within the OpenMRS project, including fetching latest versions, snapshots, and update files.

classes.name: ChangeLogVersionFinder
classes.description: Provides methods for discovering and managing Liquibase change log versions, snapshots, and update filenames for the OpenMRS project's database migration management.

methods.name: getChangeLogCombinations
methods.description: Returns a sorted map of snapshot versions and their associated change log filenames, including snapshots and updates.

methods.name: getSnapshotCombinations
methods.description: Returns a sorted map of snapshot versions and their snapshot filenames.

methods.name: getSnapshotFilenames
methods.description: Given a version, returns the list of corresponding snapshot filenames for schema-only and core data.

methods.name: getLatestSnapshotVersion
methods.description: Returns an optional containing the latest snapshot version.

methods.name: getLatestSchemaSnapshotFilename
methods.description: Returns an optional filename for the latest schema snapshot.

methods.name: getLatestCoreDataSnapshotFilename
methods.description: Returns an optional filename for the latest core data snapshot.

methods.name: getUpdateVersionsGreaterThan
methods.description: Returns a list of update versions that are greater than the specified version.

methods.name: getUpdateFileNames
methods.description: Given a list of versions, returns the list of corresponding update filenames.

methods.name: getSnapshotVersions
methods.description: Retrieves the list of all snapshot versions, delegated to changeLogVersions.

methods.name: getUpdateVersions
methods.description: Retrieves the list of all update versions, delegated to changeLogVersions.

methods.name: getVersionAsDotX
methods.description: Converts a version string into a 'major.minor.x' format, using regex to extract major and minor parts.
